text: The obvious guess is that they lost because you cannot sue a state government. That is wrong. They could and they did.
provenance: The obvious guess is that they lost because you cannot sue a state government. That is wrong. They could and they did. The case was filed, consolidated, heard, briefed and argued, and it went all the way to the Third District Court of Appeal.

text: The Department of Water Resources argued that a mandatory evacuation had not really been binding. There is no penalty for staying.
provenance: The Department of Water Resources argued in the lower court that a mandatory evacuation had not really been binding. There is no penalty for staying. Nobody comes to your house and carries you out. Some jurisdictions ordered, some recommended, and people made up their own minds.

text: That was argued. It is on the record. And it is not what the court decided.

text: In fact, the evidence and briefing demonstrated there was no defined mandatory evacuation zone, and no defined group to which an order was issued.
provenance: > In fact, the evidence and briefing submitted to the trial court demonstrated there was no defined mandatory evacuation zone and no defined group to which a mandatory evacuation order was issued.

text: No defined zone. Not a zone that was drawn too widely, or drawn in the wrong place, or drawn and then lost. There was never a zone.
provenance: No defined zone. Not a zone that was drawn too widely, or drawn in the wrong place, or drawn and then lost. There was never a zone.

text: The orders did not describe a specific area, but rather such vague areas as: the low levels of Oroville and areas downstream.
provenance: > They did not describe a specific area but rather such vague areas as: low levels of Oroville and areas downstream, the portion of Yuba County that is on the valley floor, and other communities along the Feather River.

text: The instinctive picture of a mandatory evacuation is a map with a line on it, and a list of streets inside the line.
provenance: The instinctive picture of a mandatory evacuation is a map with a line on it and a list of streets inside the line. That picture is what makes the word mandatory mean anything at all. And when the state and the plaintiffs between them put everything they had in front of a court, what the court found in the evidence was that no such line had ever been drawn.
